title: Every save overwrites the whole notes array from one tab's stale memory, so a second tab silently deletes the first tab's notes
evidence: saveNotes writes the entire in-memory array under one key. app.js loads once (app.js:17-18) and never listens for the 'storage' event or re-reads before writing (app.js:33). Driven with Playwright in one browser context: tab A created Alpha; tab B loaded and saw ['Alpha']; tab A created 'FromTabA' (storage = ['Alpha','FromTabA']); tab B then edited the body of Alpha; storage became ['Alpha'].
failing_case: Open the app in two tabs. Create a note in tab 1. Type in any note in tab 2 (opened before the new note existed). After 500 ms tab 2 saves its stale array, and the note created in tab 1 is gone from storage. Tab 2 shows 'Saved'. Reload and the note is lost, and nothing was reported.
remediation: Before each write, re-read storage and merge by note id (or write one key per note), and listen for the 'storage' event to refresh the in-memory list and the list view. Report a conflict instead of showing 'Saved'.

title: renderList rebuilds every button, so keyboard focus falls to <body> after opening or deleting a note
evidence: Driven: focused the first '.open' button and pressed Enter; document.activeElement was BODY afterwards. Same after confirming Delete via Enter. selectNote (app.js:100) and deleteNote (app.js:121) both call renderList, which replaces all li/button nodes.
failing_case: A keyboard or screen-reader user tabs to a note, presses Enter to open it. The focused button is destroyed and focus drops to the document. The next Tab starts from the top or an arbitrary place, and the user must tab back through the toolbar to reach the editor or the next note. After Delete the same happens, with no announcement of what was deleted. WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order (A) and 3.2.2-style loss of context.
remediation: Re-render keyed by note id and reuse existing nodes, or restore focus after render: refocus the matching '.open' button after select, and after delete move focus to the next note's button or to the New note button.

title: A new note created while a search is active is selected in the editor but missing from the list, and the list says 'No notes match'
evidence: Driven: typed 'zzz' in search, clicked New note. The list had 0 items, #empty read 'No notes match "zzz".', and the editor held the new 'Untitled' note. createNote (app.js:103-111) never clears the filter.
failing_case: Search 'zzz', press New note. The editor is enabled and focused with 'Untitled', yet the sidebar claims nothing matches and shows no highlighted note. Once the user types a title that does not contain the query, the note never appears in the list until the search is cleared.
remediation: Clear the search box (and call searchShared('')) in createNote before selecting the new note, or always include the current note in the shown list.

title: The field labelled 'Search notes' matches titles only, so a word that is in a note body reports 'No notes match'
evidence: index.html:14 labels the field 'Search notes'. renderList filters on n.title only; body is never consulted.
failing_case: Note titled 'Groceries' with body 'buy oat milk'. Search 'oat': the list is empty and the message reads 'No notes match "oat"', though a note contains it.
remediation: Match against body as well as title, or relabel the field 'Search titles' and make the empty message say so.
